name: Poker
tagline: Texas hold'em with everyone in the workspace

offers.label: Take a seat
offers.description: Takes a seat at the table, with a buy-in of chips.

offers.label: Deal next hand
offers.description: Deals the next hand: shuffles, moves the button and posts the blinds.

offers.label: Move the hand on
offers.description: Moves the hand on once its street's betting is done: the next player's turn, the next cards

offers.label: Close bets
offers.description: Puts every player's bet back to zero for the next street: what closing a street's betting

offers.label: Settle hand
offers.description: Pays the pots and ends the hand. The rules of the table call it once the hand is decided; a

offers.label: Check or call
offers.description: Checks when nobody has bet, or calls the bet you face.

offers.label: Bet or raise
offers.description: Bets or raises to a total for this street.

asks.name: to
asks.description: Your total bet on this street after the raise

offers.label: Show my cards
offers.description: Shows your cards to the table after the hand.

offers.label: Fold for the slow player
offers.description: Folds the hand of a player who has taken longer than their turn.

offers.label: Buy back in
offers.description: Buys back in once you have no chips.
